description: Help agent that tells you the TypeAgent command or phrasing for what you want to do.

schema.description: Finds the TypeAgent command or action for what the user wants to do. Use for questions like 'what's the command for X', 'how do I X in TypeAgent', or 'is there a command to X'. Returns the matching @-command(s) and the equivalent natural-language phrasing(s). Do NOT use for general-knowledge questions, web lookups, or actually performing the task in another domain such as playing music, sending email, editing code, or controlling a browser.
